items.source: Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document. Can return either the same or a modified instance of the Document object.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在从Document反序列化域对象后调用。可以返回原始实例或修改后的Document对象实例。

items.source: Callback being invoked after a Document is read from Elasticsearch and before it is converted into a domain object.
items.translation: 在从 Elasticsearch 读取Document之后、将其转换为领域对象之前，回调将被调用。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在从Document反序列化域对象后被调用。

items.source: a possible modified or new Document.
items.translation: 一个可能的修改版或新的Document。

items.source: indexCoordinates - of the index the document was read from.
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
